items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did some stuff for the, Dave Pell Octet, is that good and I did some string charts

ctx.x: I did some stuff for the, Dave Pell Octet, is that good and I did some string charts, yeah that’s right Chet Baker and strings. I still knew very little about string writing.
It was also a very small string section.
